result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Web Administrator to join our team and take ownership of our web presence, infrastructure, and digital platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining websites while delivering reliable web technology solutions that support the organisation's objectives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our web environments are secure, performant, and continuously optimised. The ideal candidate brings a strong technical foundation, a proactive mindset, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain websites and web applications, ensuring consistent functionality, visual integrity, and a positive user experience across all platforms
- Monitor and manage web server performance, uptime, and availability, responding promptly to incidents and implementing preventative measures to minimise disruption
- Administer and configure web hosting environments, domains, DNS settings, and SSL certificates to ensure secure and reliable operation
- Collaborate with content, marketing, and development teams to publish, update, and manage web content in accordance with brand guidelines and accessibility standards
- Implement and maintain web security protocols, including regular vulnerability assessments, software patching, and user access controls to safeguard digital assets
- Analyse web traffic data and performance metrics using analytics tools, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve engagement and site effectiveness
- Manage and maintain content management systems (CMS), including configuration, plugin or module updates, and user permission management
- Develop and enforce web standards, coding best practices, and documentation to ensure consistency and maintainability across all web properties
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to websites, web applications, and integrations in a timely and effective manner
- Support the planning and execution of website migrations, upgrades, and redesign projects, coordinating with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors as required
- Conduct regular audits of website content, links, and functionality to identify and rectify errors, broken pages, or outdated information
- Provide technical guidance and support to internal users on web-related tools, platforms, and best practices
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Web Development, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience
- Proven experience in a web administration, web development, or similar technical role
- Proficiency in core web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Hands-on experience administering web servers such as Apache or Nginx, and working within Linux or Windows server environments
- Solid understanding of DNS management, domain administration, SSL/TLS certificates, and web hosting infrastructure
- Experience managing content management systems such as WordPress, Drupal, or similar platforms
- Familiarity with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics or similar, with the ability to interpret data and report findings clearly
- Working knowledge of web security best practices, including vulnerability management and access control
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Google Analytics, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or CompTIA Security+
- Experience with version control systems such as Git and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or deployment workflows
- Knowledge of PHP, Python, or other server-side scripting languages
- Experience with SEO best practices and web accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1
- Exposure to cloud-based hosting platforms including AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure
- Experience working within agile or collaborative project delivery environments
- Familiarity with web performance optimisation techniques, including caching strategies and content delivery networks (CDNs)
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and shared success
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including training, certifications, and attendance at industry events
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options that support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and meaningful projects that have a genuine impact on the organisation's digital presence and growth
- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits and a supportive, inclusive workplace culture
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
At Riot, we believe in putting players first. Our Sydney-based team is partnering globally to build next-generation features and technology on an exciting Unpublished R&D Title. The team focuses on supporting the game's visual targets and content production needs - helping our artists to realize a vibrant and rich world for players to be immersed and express themselves in.

As a Senior Technical Artist, Tools & Pipeline, you’ll shape the creative engine that powers our teams - defining and elevating end-to-end workflows across disciplines including Character Art, Animation, Environment Art, Audio, and VFX. You’ll be a strategic partner to artists, Technical Art, and Engineering, evaluating tools and pipelines, clarifying production requirements, and ensuring our workflows enable creativity at scale. Your work will directly impact how ideas move from concept to shipped content, empowering multiple teams to operate efficiently in parallel production streams.

In this role, you’ll help stand up and sustain scalable tools and processes, providing hands-on technical support while gathering data and feedback to continuously improve the artist experience. You’ll build strong cross-disciplinary relationships to uncover pain points and guide meaningful system and pipeline improvements. As an active member of Riot’s Technical Art community, you’ll mentor fellow TAs, contribute to craft growth, and foster a culture of knowledge sharing through clear documentation and open feedback. By setting clear goals, offering actionable direction, and championing continuous improvement, you’ll ensure our workflows not only support today’s production but evolve to meet the ambitions of tomorrow.

You will report to the Manager, Technical Art, and work closely with the Technical Art Director and other members of the team abroad.

Responsibilities:
Define and level up the end-to-end workflow for our many creative disciplines, such as Character Art, Animation, Environment Art, Audio, and VFX
Collaborate with Technical Art and Engineering partners to support artist needs, including evaluating tools and workflows, and communicating requirements for production.
Help stand up and maintain scalable artist tools and workflows to support multiple teams in parallel production streams.
Provide technical support to artists working from our art workflows, collecting data to further improve the tools they are using, making recommendations and improvements where necessary
Be an active member of the Tech Art community within Riot, participate in craft-focused meetings and events, and actively mentor for other Technical Artists in their craft
Build close relationships with artists and engineers to understand needs, identify pain points, and help guide workflow, pipeline, and system improvements.
Spread knowledge of the team’s processes through documentation and help teams expand their technical know-how
Consistently give and take constructive feedback, direct next steps, and communicate clear goals and outcomes to your team

Required Qualifications: 
6+ years of professional experience as a technical artist in games or related industries.
Professional experience in content creation and tool development for DCC tools, such as Autodesk Maya, 3DS Max, Adobe Suite, ZBrush, Houdini, Substance Suite, or Blender.
Professional experience working in Unreal Engine 5.
Highly proficient in Python tool development, with a particular focus on building scalable, maintainable, and high-performance tools for a variety of artist use-cases.
Professional experience with modern UI frameworks such as PySide & PyQt.
Strong understanding of art workflows and the ability to translate artistic needs into technical requirements.
Highly proficient communication skills and capacity to act as an ambassador between art and engineering.
Superb critical thinking skills, particularly as it pertains to translating artistic requirements to sustainable workflow design.
Proactive, responsible, and comfortable owning ambiguous or evolving problem spaces.

Desired Qualifications:
Experience with C++ and UMG for Unreal Engine 5.
Excellent UI/UX design and front-end development (especially Qt/PyQt).
Strong understanding of performance considerations for modern hardware and optimization techniques required for delivering a scalable, high performance product.
Experience working on a large-scale, AAA game with a sizable, cross-disciplinary team.
Experience with character rigging and animation pipelines.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!
